dismissed_comment: Approved by Brian: false positive. This is the public QUIC v1 Initial salt mandated by RFC 9001 section 5.2, not a credential/private key. Randomizing it breaks interoperability. Review: docs/release-evidence/0.9.3/CODEQL_TRIAGE.md.
